title: Effect of Laser Remelting on the Microstructure, Mechanical and Tribological Properties of Detonation-Sprayed NiCrFeBSiC Coatings for Mechanical Engineering Applications
authors: Dastan Buitkenov, Nurmakhanbet Raisov, Laila Sulyubayeva, A.Y. Zhakupova, Daryn Baizhan, Nurbol Berdimuratov
abstract: This study investigates the effect of laser remelting on the microstructure, phase composition, mechanical properties, tribological behavior, and corrosion resistance of self-fluxing NiCrFeBSiC coatings deposited onto AISI 321 stainless steel by detonation spraying. The coatings were characterized before and after laser treatment using scanning electron microscopy (SEM), energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDS), X-ray diffraction (XRD), instrumented indentation, adhesion testing, ball-on-disk tribometry, and potentiodynamic polarization measurements. SEM analysis revealed that laser remelting reduced coating porosity from 0.306 ± 0.014% to 0.15 ± 0.09%, accompanied by microstructural densification and a reduction in coating thickness. XRD analysis confirmed the preservation of the principal crystalline phases, including Ni3Fe, Cr7C3, CrB, and Ni3B, following laser treatment. The Vickers hardness increased from 1049.1 ± 43.4 to 1206.1 ± 63.1 HV, while the elastic modulus increased from 233.6 ± 6.2 to 258.4 ± 5.3 GPa. Furthermore, adhesion strength increased by 19.4%, whereas surface roughness decreased by 19.2%. Laser remelting significantly improved tribological performance, reducing the average coefficient of friction from 0.535 ± 0.048 to 0.409 ± 0.086 and the specific wear rate from 2.864 × 10−4 to 1.447 × 10−4 mm3/(N·m), corresponding to a 49.5% reduction in wear. Electrochemical measurements indicated a modest decrease in corrosion current density of approximately 3.0%, accompanied by changes in the morphology of corrosion-affected regions. The improvements are associated with laser-induced microstructural densification, redistribution of alloying elements, and preservation of hard reinforcing phases. These findings demonstrate the potential of combining detonation spraying with laser remelting to produce wear-resistant nickel-based protective coatings for mechanical and power engineering applications.

zh-Hans.title: 激光重熔对机械工程用爆炸喷涂NiCrFeBSiC涂层微观组织、力学性能及摩擦学性能的影响
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究考察了激光重熔对通过爆炸喷涂沉积于AISI 321不锈钢上的自熔性NiCrFeBSiC涂层的微观组织、相组成、力学性能、摩擦学行为及耐腐蚀性的影响。采用扫描电子显微镜（SEM）、能量色散X射线光谱（EDS）、X射线衍射（XRD）、仪器化压痕、结合强度测试、球-盘摩擦试验及动电位极化测量，对激光处理前后的涂层进行了表征。SEM分析表明，激光重熔使涂层孔隙率由0.306 ± 0.014%降至0.15 ± 0.09%，同时伴随微观组织致密化和涂层厚度减小。XRD分析证实，激光处理后，Ni3Fe、Cr7C3、CrB和Ni3B等主要晶相得以保留。维氏硬度由1049.1 ± 43.4 HV提高至1206.1 ± 63.1 HV，弹性模量由233.6 ± 6.2 GPa提高至258.4 ± 5.3 GPa。此外，结合强度提高了19.4%，表面粗糙度降低了19.2%。激光重熔显著改善了摩擦学性能，使平均摩擦系数由0.535 ± 0.048降至0.409 ± 0.086，比磨损率由2.864 × 10−4 mm3/(N·m)降至1.447 × 10−4 mm3/(N·m)，相当于磨损降低了49.5%。电化学测量表明，腐蚀电流密度小幅降低约3.0%，同时腐蚀影响区域的形貌发生变化。这些性能改善与激光诱导的微观组织致密化、合金元素再分布及硬质增强相的保留有关。研究结果表明，将爆炸喷涂与激光重熔相结合，在制备适用于机械与动力工程的耐磨镍基防护涂层方面具有潜力。

title: Computational and machine learning modelling approaches for weld quality predictions in friction stir welding of high-density polyethylene
authors: A. Alhourani, I. Barsoum, J. Sheikh-Ahmad, S. Deveci
abstract: Friction stir welding (FSW) has gained recognition as an effective technique for joining thermoplastic materials. This study presents a comprehensive investigation to predict FSW characteristics such as weld temperatures, vertical axial forces, material flow and defect formation in FSW of high-density polyethylene (HDPE) using both computational and machine learning approaches, validated by experimental results. A three-dimensional Coupled Eulerian-Lagrangian (CEL) numerical model is developed to simulate the HDPE welding process under varying process parameters of rotational and welding speeds, and bottom preheating conditions. The CEL numerical model is validated against experimental data, showing markedly good agreement in predicting void formation, thermal and mechanical responses. Results indicate that preheating the bottom surface proved effective in reducing thermal gradients and stabilizing vertical force fluctuations. Quantitatively, bottom-surface preheating at 60 °C reduced peak plunge force from 1600 N close to 1100 N and raised peak temperatures from 70 °C (without preheat) to about 100 °C, hence smoothing through-thickness gradients and stabilizing the axial force distribution. In parallel, two multilayer perceptron artificial neural networks (ANNs) are trained on experimental data to predict temporal temperature and axial force responses with R2 between 0.91 and 0.99, demonstrating high accuracy and strong generalization across the tested FSW parameter space. The computational CEL simulations accurately predicted weld zone morphology, including stir zone, thermo-mechanically affected zone and heat-affected zone, however the combined CEL–ANN framework enables rapid generation of process maps that highlights defective and defect-free welding windows, with optimal conditions obtained at 1500 rpm and 30 mm/min with 60 °C preheating, and poor weldability observed at 1000 rpm without preheating due to wormhole formation. These findings provide process-driven design guidelines for developing robust HDPE joints and demonstrate how integrating computational modeling with machine learning enables efficient optimization, offering valuable insights into the key characteristics of the FSW process in thermoplastics and supporting its broader adoption in industrial applications.

infographic.key_insight: Combining 3D welding simulation with neural networks identified an optimal tested HDPE friction stir welding condition of 1500 rpm, 30 mm/min and 60 °C bottom preheating.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The framework supports process-window selection to reduce weld defects, thermal gradients and axial force fluctuations in HDPE joints.

infographic.evidence_signal: Experimental validation showed good simulation agreement, ANN R² values of 0.91–0.99, and a peak plunge-force reduction from 1600 N to about 1100 N with 60 °C bottom preheating.
infographic.watch_item: Performance beyond the tested welding parameter space remains unverified and requires additional validation.
infographic.paper_title: Computational and machine learning modelling approaches for weld quality predictions in friction stir welding of high-density polyethylene

zh-Hans.title: 用于高密度聚乙烯搅拌摩擦焊焊接质量预测的计算建模与机器学习建模方法
zh-Hans.abstract: 搅拌摩擦焊（FSW）已被认可为连接热塑性材料的一种有效技术。本研究综合采用计算方法和机器学习方法，对高密度聚乙烯（HDPE）搅拌摩擦焊中的焊接温度、垂直轴向力、材料流动和缺陷形成等特征进行预测，并通过实验结果加以验证。研究建立了三维耦合欧拉–拉格朗日（CEL）数值模型，用于模拟不同转速、焊接速度和底部预热条件下的HDPE焊接过程。CEL数值模型经实验数据验证，在孔洞形成以及热响应和力学响应的预测方面均表现出很高的一致性。结果表明，底面预热可有效减小温度梯度，并抑制垂直力波动。定量而言，60 °C底面预热使峰值压入力从1600 N降至接近1100 N，并使峰值温度从未预热时的70 °C升至约100 °C，从而减缓厚度方向的温度梯度，并使轴向力分布更加稳定。同时，利用实验数据训练了两个多层感知机人工神经网络（ANN），以预测温度和轴向力随时间的响应，R2介于0.91与0.99之间，表明其在所测试的FSW参数空间内具有较高的准确性和较强的泛化能力。CEL计算模拟准确预测了焊接区域形貌，包括搅拌区、热机械影响区和热影响区；而CEL–ANN联合框架能够快速生成工艺图，标示存在缺陷和无缺陷的焊接工艺窗口。在1500 rpm、30 mm/min并采用60 °C预热时获得了最优条件，而在1000 rpm且不预热时，由于形成虫洞缺陷，观察到较差的可焊性。这些发现为制备可靠的HDPE接头提供了以工艺为导向的设计指南，并展示了计算建模与机器学习的集成如何实现高效优化，为理解热塑性材料FSW过程的关键特征提供了有价值的见解，同时支持该技术在工业应用中的更广泛采用。

infographic.key_insight: 结合三维焊接模拟与神经网络，确定了所测试的HDPE搅拌摩擦焊条件中的最优组合：1500 rpm、30 mm/min和60 °C底部预热。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该框架支持焊接工艺窗口选择，以减少HDPE接头中的焊接缺陷、温度梯度和轴向力波动。
method: 采用三维耦合欧拉–拉格朗日模拟，对热、力、材料流动和孔洞形成进行建模。
利用实验测得的温度和轴向力时间历程训练两个多层感知机网络。
利用模拟和ANN预测结果，绘制存在缺陷和无缺陷的焊接条件分布图。
infographic.evidence_signal: 实验验证表明，模拟结果与实验结果具有良好的一致性，ANN的R²值为0.91–0.99，且60 °C底部预热使峰值压入力从1600 N降至约1100 N。
infographic.watch_item: 在所测试焊接参数空间之外的性能尚未得到验证，需要进一步验证。

title: Microstructure and surface performance of detonation gun sprayed 80Ni20Cr and NiCrAlY coatings on Al 6061-T6 substrate for structural applications
authors: T. Sampath kumar, Rajaram Ganesan, M.M. Reddy
abstract: Two protective coatings, 80Ni20Cr and NiCrAlY, were deposited on Al 6061-T6 alloy substrates using the Detonation Gun (D-Gun) thermal spray process. The deposited coatings were studied for their microstructure, phase composition, surface roughness, hardness, corrosion behaviour, wettability, and solid particle erosion resistance. Characterisation was done using SEM-EDS, XRD, AFM, nanoindentation, potentiodynamic polarisation, contact angle measurement, and erosion testing. SEM-EDS results showed that both coatings bonded well to the substrate with uniform thickness. The NiCrAlY coating had a denser microstructure with lower porosity compared to 80Ni20Cr. XRD identified CrNi phases with FCC crystal structure in 80Ni20Cr and Al₂NiY phases with orthorhombic structure in NiCrAlY. Nanocrystalline grain structure was observed in both coatings. AFM measurements showed that NiCrAlY had the lowest surface roughness among all three samples. Nanoindentation results showed that NiCrAlY hardness is approximately 10 times higher than 80Ni20Cr. Specifically, NiCrAlY showed a hardness of 7895.36 MPa (731.2 HV), compared with 780.11 MPa (72.25 HV) for 80Ni20Cr and 708.68 MPa for the uncoated Al 6061 substrate. Potentiodynamic polarisation tests in 3.5 wt% NaCl solution confirmed that NiCrAlY recorded the lowest corrosion current density of 6.625 × 10 -7 A/cm² and a corrosion rate of 0.00567 mmpy. The 80Ni20Cr coating gave a corrosion current density of 1.585 × 10 - 6 A/cm² and a corrosion rate of 0.01427 mmpy. Both figures are considerably lower than the bare substrate at 0.5185 mmpy. Contact angle measurements confirmed superhydrophobic behaviour for NiCrAlY and near-superhydrophobic behaviour for 80Ni20Cr. Solid particle erosion test results showed that 80Ni20Cr recorded the lowest mass loss. Under the laboratory conditions used (3.5 wt% NaCl at room temperature; a single erosion condition of 90° impact angle, 40 m/s and 5 min), NiCrAlY showed the better hardness and corrosion resistance, whereas 80Ni20Cr showed the better erosion resistance. These results indicate relative performance under the test conditions and are not a prediction of long-term service life.

infographic.key_insight: D-Gun-sprayed NiCrAlY delivered better hardness and corrosion resistance, while 80Ni20Cr showed lower erosion mass loss on Al 6061-T6.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Coating selection should match the dominant damage mode: NiCrAlY for hardness and corrosion protection, or 80Ni20Cr for erosion resistance under the tested conditions.
method: Deposited 80Ni20Cr and NiCrAlY coatings on Al 6061-T6 using detonation gun spraying.

zh-Hans.title: 用于结构应用的 Al 6061-T6 基体上爆炸喷涂 80Ni20Cr 和 NiCrAlY 涂层的微观组织与表面性能
zh-Hans.abstract: 采用爆炸喷涂（D-Gun）热喷涂工艺，在 Al 6061-T6 合金基体上沉积了 80Ni20Cr 和 NiCrAlY 两种防护涂层。研究了所沉积涂层的微观组织、相组成、表面粗糙度、硬度、腐蚀行为、润湿性及抗固体颗粒冲蚀性能。采用 SEM-EDS、XRD、AFM、纳米压痕、动电位极化、接触角测量和冲蚀试验进行表征。SEM-EDS 结果表明，两种涂层均与基体结合良好，且厚度均匀。与 80Ni20Cr 相比，NiCrAlY 涂层的微观组织更致密，孔隙率更低。XRD 在 80Ni20Cr 中鉴定出具有面心立方（FCC）晶体结构的 CrNi 相，在 NiCrAlY 中鉴定出具有正交晶体结构的 Al₂NiY 相。两种涂层中均观察到纳米晶粒组织。AFM 测量表明，在全部三个样品中，NiCrAlY 的表面粗糙度最低。纳米压痕结果表明，NiCrAlY 的硬度约为 80Ni20Cr 的 10 倍。具体而言，NiCrAlY 的硬度为 7895.36 MPa（731.2 HV），而 80Ni20Cr 的硬度为 780.11 MPa（72.25 HV），未涂覆 Al 6061 基体的硬度为 708.68 MPa。在 3.5 wt% NaCl 溶液中进行的动电位极化试验证实，NiCrAlY 的腐蚀电流密度最低，为 6.625 × 10⁻⁷ A/cm²，腐蚀速率为 0.00567 mmpy。80Ni20Cr 涂层的腐蚀电流密度为 1.585 × 10⁻⁶ A/cm²，腐蚀速率为 0.01427 mmpy。两种涂层的腐蚀速率均显著低于裸基体的 0.5185 mmpy。接触角测量证实，NiCrAlY 表现出超疏水性，80Ni20Cr 则表现出接近超疏水的特性。固体颗粒冲蚀试验结果表明，80Ni20Cr 的质量损失最低。在所采用的实验室条件下（室温下的 3.5 wt% NaCl 溶液；单一冲蚀工况：冲击角度为 90°、速度为 40 m/s、持续时间为 5 min），NiCrAlY 表现出更高的硬度和更好的耐腐蚀性，而 80Ni20Cr 表现出更好的抗冲蚀性能。这些结果反映了试验条件下的相对性能，并不构成对长期服役寿命的预测。

infographic.key_insight: 在 Al 6061-T6 上，D-Gun 喷涂的 NiCrAlY 涂层表现出更高的硬度和更好的耐腐蚀性，而 80Ni20Cr 涂层的冲蚀质量损失更低。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 涂层选择应与主导损伤模式相匹配：在所测试条件下，若侧重硬度和腐蚀防护，可选择 NiCrAlY；若侧重抗冲蚀性能，可选择 80Ni20Cr。

采用 SEM-EDS、XRD、AFM 和纳米压痕表征微观组织、物相、粗糙度和硬度。

title: Microstructure, Wear and Corrosion Resistances of Atmospheric Plasma, Detonation, High Velocity Oxy-fuel and High Velocity Air-fuel Sprayed WC-10Co-4Cr Cemented Carbide Coatings
authors: Ting XIA, Yueming WANG, Lu XIE
abstract: WC-10Co-4Cr cemented carbide coating has the advantages of superior wear property and corrosion resistance. WC-10Co-4Cr coatings were prepared on 304 stainless steel substrates by different thermal spray technologies including atmospheric plasma spraying (APS), detonation spraying (DS), high velocity oxy-fuel spraying (HVOFS), and high velocity air-fuel spraying (HVAFS), respectively. The microstructure, tribological properties and corrosion resistances of WC-10Co-4Cr coatings were systematically investigated and compared. The results showed that the Vickers hardness of cemented coatings prepared by APS, DS, HVOF, and HVAF, which were all higher than those of 304 stainless steel, were 771.4 HV, 954.2 HV, 1166.2 HV, and 1162.2 HV, respectively. The volume wear rate of 304 stainless steel was about (36.82±0.80)×10-5 mm3/N·m. The volume wear rates of APS, DS, HVOF, and HVAF coatings, which were all lower than that of 304 stainless steel, were about (7.93±0.30)×10-5, (1.51±0.20)×10-5, (1.17±0.10)×10-5, and (1.10±0.01)×10-5 mm3/N·m, respectively. In addition, the average friction coefficients of 304 stainless steel substrate, APS coating, DS one, HVOF one and HVAF one were about (0.68±0.03), (0.56±0.02), (0.48±0.01), (0.44±0.01) and (0.43±0.01), respectively. Spalling, microcracks perpendicular to the friction direction, and grooves parallel to the friction direction can be found in the wear marks of WC-10Co-4Cr coatings. Abrasive wear and fatigue wear are the main wear mechanisms of the cemented coatings. During the wear test, the carbide particles in DS, HVOF and HVAF coatings gradually became the main body bearing the friction load. Then the wear resistance of the latter three coatings was all superior to that of APS. Moreover, HVOF and HVAF coatings have better wear performances. For corrosion resistance from high to low were HVAF coating, DS one, HVOF one and APS one, respectively. The HVAF coating demonstrated the highest corrosion potential (-0.37±0.01 VSCE), smallest corrosion current density (1.75±0.02 μA/cm²), and largest corrosion resistance (20438.5 Ω) here. The APS coating had the poorest corrosion resistance among these four coatings.

infographic.key_insight: HVAF-sprayed WC-10Co-4Cr combined the lowest measured wear rate with the best corrosion resistance, while HVOF produced the highest hardness.
infographic.engineering_relevance: For wear- and corrosion-exposed 304 stainless steel components, HVAF is a promising coating route when both properties matter.
method: Deposit WC-10Co-4Cr on 304 stainless steel using APS, detonation, HVOF and HVAF spraying.
Compare microstructure, Vickers hardness, friction and volumetric wear rates.
Evaluate corrosion potential, current density and resistance.
infographic.evidence_signal: HVAF reduced wear rate from (36.82±0.80)×10⁻⁵ to (1.10±0.01)×10⁻⁵ mm³/(N·m), approximately 33-fold versus uncoated steel, and achieved the highest reported corrosion resistance of 20,438.5 Ω.

zh-Hans.title: 大气等离子喷涂、爆炸喷涂、超音速火焰喷涂和超音速空气燃料喷涂WC-10Co-4Cr硬质合金涂层的微观组织、耐磨性与耐蚀性
zh-Hans.abstract: WC-10Co-4Cr硬质合金涂层具有优异的耐磨性和耐蚀性。采用大气等离子喷涂（APS）、爆炸喷涂（DS）、超音速火焰喷涂（HVOFS）和超音速空气燃料喷涂（HVAFS）等不同热喷涂技术，分别在304不锈钢基体上制备了WC-10Co-4Cr涂层。系统研究并比较了WC-10Co-4Cr涂层的微观组织、摩擦学性能和耐蚀性。结果表明，采用APS、DS、HVOF和HVAF制备的硬质合金涂层的维氏硬度分别为771.4 HV、954.2 HV、1166.2 HV和1162.2 HV，均高于304不锈钢。304不锈钢的体积磨损率约为(36.82±0.80)×10⁻⁵ mm³/(N·m)。APS、DS、HVOF和HVAF涂层的体积磨损率分别约为(7.93±0.30)×10⁻⁵、(1.51±0.20)×10⁻⁵、(1.17±0.10)×10⁻⁵和(1.10±0.01)×10⁻⁵ mm³/(N·m)，均低于304不锈钢。此外，304不锈钢基体、APS涂层、DS涂层、HVOF涂层和HVAF涂层的平均摩擦系数分别约为(0.68±0.03)、(0.56±0.02)、(0.48±0.01)、(0.44±0.01)和(0.43±0.01)。在WC-10Co-4Cr涂层的磨痕中可观察到剥落、垂直于摩擦方向的微裂纹以及平行于摩擦方向的沟槽。磨粒磨损和疲劳磨损是这些硬质合金涂层的主要磨损机制。在磨损试验过程中，DS、HVOF和HVAF涂层中的碳化物颗粒逐渐成为承受摩擦载荷的主体。因此，后三种涂层的耐磨性均优于APS涂层，其中HVOF和HVAF涂层的耐磨性能更好。耐蚀性从高到低依次为HVAF涂层、DS涂层、HVOF涂层和APS涂层。在本研究中，HVAF涂层表现出最高的腐蚀电位(-0.37±0.01 VSCE)、最小的腐蚀电流密度(1.75±0.02 μA/cm²)和最大的腐蚀电阻(20438.5 Ω)。在这四种涂层中，APS涂层的耐蚀性最差。

infographic.key_insight: HVAF喷涂的WC-10Co-4Cr涂层兼具最低的实测磨损率和最佳的耐蚀性，而HVOF制备的涂层硬度最高。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 对于承受磨损和腐蚀的304不锈钢部件，当两种性能均需兼顾时，HVAF是一种有前景的涂层制备工艺。
method: 采用APS、爆炸喷涂、HVOF和HVAF在304不锈钢上沉积WC-10Co-4Cr涂层。
比较微观组织、维氏硬度、摩擦性能和体积磨损率。
评估腐蚀电位、腐蚀电流密度和腐蚀电阻。
infographic.evidence_signal: HVAF将磨损率从(36.82±0.80)×10⁻⁵降至(1.10±0.01)×10⁻⁵ mm³/(N·m)，约为未涂覆不锈钢的1/33，并获得了所报告的最高腐蚀电阻20,438.5 Ω。
infographic.watch_item: 摘要未说明磨损试验条件或腐蚀介质，因此这些性能排序需要在预期服役条件下进行验证。

title: Non-Destructive Evaluation for Engineered Surfaces: Methods, In-Process Sensing, and Data-Driven Inspection in the NDE 4.0 Era
authors: Kuldeep Sharma, R. P. Sharma
abstract: Engineered surfaces such as coatings, diffusion layers, cold-sprayed deposits, laser-clad overlays, additively manufactured surface regions, peened layers, and anodised films increasingly determine the performance, inspect ability, and service life of high-value metallic and ceramic components. Wear, corrosion, fatigue, oxidation, debonding, and crack initiation are controlled in these shallow, graded, anisotropic, and interface- dominated regions. This review examines how non-destructive evaluation (NDE) methods can be selected and qualified for them. It links inspection physics to specific problems: coating thickness and adhesion, near- surface residual stress, porosity gradients, lack of fusion, thermal-barrier-coating debonding, weak cold-spray interfaces, and additive-manufacturing surface roughness. Magnetic Barkhausen noise, eddy-current testing, active infrared thermography, phased-array and laser ultrasonics, acoustic emission, optical metrology, digital image correlation, microwave and terahertz sensing, and X-ray computed tomography are assessed for both capability and limitation. The review argues for hierarchical, multi-modal strategies in which rapid screening is followed by calibrated confirmation where required. It also covers the shift toward NDE 4.0, including in- process sensing, data fusion, physics-informed machine learning, uncertainty-aware interpretation, and digital twins. Persistent barriers include limited probability-of-detection evidence, poor transferability of data-driven models, scarce reference specimens, and incomplete acceptance criteria
venue: South Mediterranean University Journal of Pure and Applied Sciences

infographic.key_insight: Engineered surfaces require hierarchical, multi-modal NDE that pairs rapid screening with calibrated confirmation tailored to surface and interface properties.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Matching inspection physics to coating thickness, adhesion, residual stress, porosity, and debonding can support quality control and service-life assessment.
method: Review electromagnetic, thermal, acoustic, optical, and X-ray inspection capabilities and limitations.
Link NDE methods to defects in coatings, cold-sprayed deposits, clad overlays, and other engineered surfaces.
Assess in-process sensing, data fusion, physics-informed machine learning, and digital twins for NDE 4.0.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract describes a methods review, not a new experimental benchmark, and highlights limited probability-of-detection evidence.
infographic.watch_item: Qualification remains constrained by scarce reference specimens, incomplete acceptance criteria, and poor transferability of data-driven models.
infographic.paper_title: Non-Destructive Evaluation for Engineered Surfaces: Methods, In-Process Sensing, and Data-Driven Inspection in the NDE 4.0 Era

zh-Hans.title: 工程化表面的无损评价：NDE 4.0 时代的方法、过程传感与数据驱动检测
zh-Hans.abstract: 涂层、扩散层、冷喷涂沉积层、激光熔覆层、增材制造表面区域、喷丸强化层和阳极氧化膜等工程化表面，日益决定着高价值金属及陶瓷部件的性能、可检测性和服役寿命。磨损、腐蚀、疲劳、氧化、脱粘和裂纹萌生受这些浅层、具有梯度和各向异性且由界面主导的区域控制。本综述探讨如何针对这些区域选择无损评价（NDE）方法并验证其适用性，将检测物理原理与具体问题联系起来，包括涂层厚度与附着力、近表面残余应力、孔隙率梯度、未熔合、热障涂层脱粘、冷喷涂界面结合薄弱以及增材制造表面粗糙度。综述评估了磁巴克豪森噪声、涡流检测、主动红外热成像、相控阵超声与激光超声、声发射、光学计量、数字图像相关、微波与太赫兹传感以及 X 射线计算机断层成像的能力与局限性。综述主张采用分层、多模态策略，即先进行快速筛查，再在必要时采用经过校准的方法进行确认。综述还涵盖了向 NDE 4.0 的转变，包括过程传感、数据融合、物理信息机器学习、考虑不确定性的解读以及数字孪生。持续存在的障碍包括检出概率证据有限、数据驱动模型的可迁移性较差、参考试样稀缺以及验收准则不完善。

infographic.key_insight: 工程化表面需要分层、多模态的 NDE，将快速筛查与针对表面及界面特性、经过校准的确认检测相结合。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 将检测物理原理与涂层厚度、附着力、残余应力、孔隙率和脱粘问题相匹配，可为质量控制和服役寿命评估提供支持。
method: 综述电磁、热学、声学、光学和 X 射线检测的能力与局限性。
将 NDE 方法与涂层、冷喷涂沉积层、熔覆层及其他工程化表面中的缺陷联系起来。
评估面向 NDE 4.0 的过程传感、数据融合、物理信息机器学习和数字孪生。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要描述的是一项方法综述，而非新的实验基准研究，并强调检出概率证据有限。
infographic.watch_item: 适用性验证仍受到参考试样稀缺、验收准则不完善以及数据驱动模型可迁移性较差的制约。

title: Microstructure and high-temperature oxidation behaviour of HVOF and plasma sprayed Ni–Cr-based ceramic coatings on SA516 boiler steel
authors: Ankur Gill, Vikas Chawla, Amit Handa, Santosh Kumar
abstract: This study investigates the microstructural and high-temperature oxidation behaviour of SA516 boiler steel coated with Ni-20Cr, Ni-20Cr+40TiC, and Ni-20Cr+40TiN using High Velocity Oxygen Fuel (HVOF) and Plasma Spray (PS) techniques. The cyclic air oxidation tests were performed for fifty cycles at 900°C in a simulated laboratory environment, and the resulting microstructural and phase changes were analyzed by means of X-ray Diffraction (XRD), Scanning Electron Microscopy with Energy Dispersive Spectroscopy (SEM/EDS), and X-ray mapping. The uncoated SA516 steel experienced intense spalling and cracking of the oxide layer, developing an unprotected phase (Fe 2 O 3 ). Among all coatings, the HVOF-sprayed Ni-20Cr+40TiC coating diminished maximum weight gain by 95.71 % compared to bare SA516 steel, indicating superior oxidation resistance. This enhanced performance of coatings is attributed to formation a dense, protective oxide layer consisting of Cr 2 O 3 , TiO 2 , NiTiO 4 , and NiO, coupled with reduced porosity and enhanced microhardness.

infographic.key_insight: HVOF-sprayed Ni-20Cr+40TiC reduced oxidation weight gain by 95.71% versus bare SA516 steel, giving the best oxidation resistance among the tested coatings.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Ni–Cr-based coatings could improve oxidation protection for SA516 boiler steel exposed to high temperatures.
method: Apply Ni-20Cr, Ni-20Cr+40TiC, and Ni-20Cr+40TiN coatings using HVOF and plasma spraying.
Conduct 50 cyclic air-oxidation tests at 900°C.
Characterize phases and microstructure using XRD, SEM/EDS, and X-ray mapping.
infographic.evidence_signal: The reported 95.71% reduction in weight gain accompanied protective oxide formation, while bare steel showed intense oxide-layer spalling and cracking.
infographic.watch_item: Performance was evaluated under laboratory air oxidation; durability in actual boiler combustion environments remains to be established.
infographic.paper_title: Microstructure and high-temperature oxidation behaviour of HVOF and plasma sprayed Ni–Cr-based ceramic coatings on SA516 boiler steel

zh-Hans.title: SA516锅炉钢表面HVOF及等离子喷涂Ni–Cr基陶瓷涂层的微观组织与高温氧化行为
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究采用超音速火焰喷涂（HVOF）和等离子喷涂（PS）技术，在SA516锅炉钢表面制备Ni-20Cr、Ni-20Cr+40TiC和Ni-20Cr+40TiN涂层，并研究其微观组织与高温氧化行为。在模拟实验室环境中，于900°C下进行50次循环空气氧化试验，并利用X射线衍射（XRD）、配备能量色散谱的扫描电子显微镜（SEM/EDS）及X射线元素面分布分析，研究试验后的微观组织与物相变化。未涂覆的SA516钢氧化层发生严重剥落和开裂，并形成不具保护性的物相（Fe 2 O 3）。在所有涂层中，与裸露SA516钢相比，HVOF喷涂的Ni-20Cr+40TiC涂层使最大增重降低了95.71%，表明其具有优异的抗氧化性能。涂层性能的提升归因于形成了由Cr 2 O 3、TiO 2、NiTiO 4和NiO组成的致密保护性氧化层，同时孔隙率降低、显微硬度提高。

infographic.key_insight: 与裸露SA516钢相比，HVOF喷涂的Ni-20Cr+40TiC涂层使氧化增重降低了95.71%，在所测试的涂层中表现出最佳的抗氧化性能。
infographic.engineering_relevance: Ni–Cr基涂层有望提高高温环境下SA516锅炉钢的抗氧化防护能力。
method: 采用HVOF和等离子喷涂技术制备Ni-20Cr、Ni-20Cr+40TiC和Ni-20Cr+40TiN涂层。
在900°C下进行50次循环空气氧化试验。
利用XRD、SEM/EDS和X射线元素面分布分析表征物相与微观组织。
infographic.evidence_signal: 所报告的95.71%增重降幅伴随着保护性氧化物的形成，而裸钢则出现了严重的氧化层剥落和开裂。
infographic.watch_item: 性能评估是在实验室空气氧化条件下进行的；在实际锅炉燃烧环境中的耐久性仍有待验证。

title: Molten pool dynamic behavior and arc characteristics in laser-TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel
authors: Sen WU, Fei ZHAO, Shuili GONG, Lifeng MA, Haiyan ZHAO, Wei ZHANG
abstract: Invar steel has an extremely low coefficient of thermal expansion, making it widely used in the manufacturing of molds for aerospace composite materials. Most existing studies focus on process aspects, lacking in-depth analysis of the fluid dynamics behavior of the molten pool. Therefore, numerical simulation and high-speed photography were employed to analyze the effects of different process parameters on the molten pool morphology evolution and arc characteristics during laser-TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel, which provides crucial theoretical support for the optimization of the Invar steel welding process. The results indicate that within the laser power range of 5 ~ 6 kW, the increased power leads to greater recoil pressure, which promotes a larger penetration depth and keyhole dimension, intensifies the overall molten pool flow, and makes the arc prone to being attracted by the laser and deflected at a high power. Within the welding speed range of 0.5 ~ 0.8 m/min, a higher speed reduces the heat input, leading to a decreased penetration depth and weld width, and an increased flow velocity and cooling rate of the molten pool; additionally, the arc is prone to deformation at a high speed. Within the welding current range of 150 ~ 170 A, the increased current enhances the arc force, promoting the expansion of weld width and intensifying the molten pool convection; furthermore, the arc is more stable at a high current.

infographic.key_insight: In laser–TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel, laser power primarily increases penetration, welding current broadens the weld and stabilizes the arc, and welding speed reduces weld dimensions.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Balancing these parameters can support weld geometry and arc stability control when joining low-expansion Invar components for aerospace composite molds.
method: Numerical simulation of molten pool dynamics
High-speed photography of welding behavior
Analysis of laser power, welding speed, and current effects
infographic.evidence_signal: Across 5–6 kW, 0.5–0.8 m/min, and 150–170 A, the abstract reports increased penetration with power, reduced penetration and width with speed, and wider welds with more stable arcs at higher current.
infographic.watch_item: The reported trends apply to limited parameter ranges; the abstract provides no quantitative simulation–experiment agreement or weld mechanical-property validation.
infographic.paper_title: Molten pool dynamic behavior and arc characteristics in laser-TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel

zh-Hans.title: Invar钢激光-TIG复合焊接中的熔池动态行为与电弧特性
zh-Hans.abstract: Invar钢具有极低的热膨胀系数，因此广泛用于航空航天复合材料模具的制造。现有研究大多侧重于工艺方面，缺乏对熔池流体动力学行为的深入分析。因此，本研究采用数值模拟和高速摄影，分析不同工艺参数对Invar钢激光-TIG复合焊接过程中熔池形态演变及电弧特性的影响，为Invar钢焊接工艺优化提供重要的理论支持。结果表明，在5 ~ 6 kW的激光功率范围内，功率增大使反冲压力升高，从而增大熔深和小孔尺寸，增强熔池整体流动，并使电弧在高功率下更易受到激光吸引而发生偏转。在0.5 ~ 0.8 m/min的焊接速度范围内，焊接速度提高使热输入减少，导致熔深和焊缝宽度减小，熔池流速和冷却速率增大；此外，电弧在高焊接速度下易发生变形。在150 ~ 170 A的焊接电流范围内，电流增大使电弧力增强，促进焊缝宽度增大并强化熔池对流；此外，电弧在高电流下更加稳定。

infographic.key_insight: 在Invar钢激光–TIG复合焊接中，提高激光功率主要增大熔深，提高焊接电流使焊缝变宽并稳定电弧，而提高焊接速度则减小焊缝尺寸。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 在连接用于航空航天复合材料模具的低膨胀Invar构件时，平衡这些参数有助于控制焊缝几何形状和电弧稳定性。
method: 熔池动力学数值模拟
焊接行为高速摄影
激光功率、焊接速度和电流的影响分析
infographic.evidence_signal: 在5–6 kW、0.5–0.8 m/min和150–170 A的参数范围内，摘要报告了以下趋势：熔深随功率增大而增大，熔深和焊缝宽度随焊接速度提高而减小，以及在较高电流下焊缝更宽、电弧更稳定。
infographic.watch_item: 所报告的趋势适用于有限的参数范围；摘要未提供数值模拟与实验吻合程度的定量结果，也未提供焊缝力学性能验证。

title: EFFECT OF CEO2 AND LA2O3 REINFORCEMENTS ON MECHANICAL, TRIBOLOGICAL AND MICROSTRUCTURAL PROPERTIES OF WC–12CO COATING BY HIGH-VELOCITY OXYGEN FUEL DEPOSITION TECHNIQUE
authors: Satyanarayan Dubey, Shyam Birla, Tribhuwan Kishore Mishra
abstract: Decarburization during HVOF deposition reduces the workability of Tungsten Carbide-12% Cobalt (WC-12Co) coatings. This work examines how CeO2 and La2O3 reinforcements affect HVOF-sprayed WC-12Co coatings' mechanical, tribological, and microstructural characteristics. Compared to the unreinforced coating, microstructure, phase composition, bond strength, abrasive wear, coefficient of friction, and microhardness were assessed. CeO2 or La2O3 decreased porosity and finer grain structure without affecting bond strength. Coatings with 1 wt.% CeO2 and La2O3 increased microhardness by 6% and 4%, respectively, compared to the unreinforced WC-12Co coating, which had an adhesive bond strength of 73.60 ± 5 MPa. Both changed coatings improved structural stability, grain refinement, and densification. Minimum wear rate of 3.5 × 10⁻⁵ mm³/N·m was found in WC-12Co-1La2O3, whereas the lowest coefficient of friction was 0.4 in WC-12Co-1CeO2. An oxide layer from reinforcements enhanced wear resistance. SEM investigation of worn surfaces showed debris, dislodged carbide particles, SiC grains, microcracks, and grooves as the predominant wear processes.

infographic.key_insight: Adding 1 wt.% CeO2 or La2O3 to HVOF-sprayed WC–12Co reduced porosity, refined grains, and increased microhardness without compromising bond strength.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Rare-earth oxide additions offer a route to denser WC–12Co coatings with improved wear performance for wear-critical components.
method: Deposit unreinforced and CeO2- or La2O3-reinforced WC–12Co coatings using HVOF.
Compare microstructure, phase composition, bond strength, microhardness, abrasive wear, and friction.
Examine worn surfaces using SEM to identify wear mechanisms.
infographic.evidence_signal: At 1 wt.% addition, CeO2 and La2O3 increased microhardness by 6% and 4%, respectively; La2O3 achieved the minimum wear rate of 3.5 × 10⁻⁵ mm³/(N·m), while CeO2 achieved the lowest friction coefficient of 0.4.
infographic.watch_item: The abstract does not specify wear-test conditions or uncertainty for the wear and friction results, limiting extrapolation to service environments.
infographic.paper_title: EFFECT OF CEO2 AND LA2O3 REINFORCEMENTS ON MECHANICAL, TRIBOLOGICAL AND MICROSTRUCTURAL PROPERTIES OF WC–12CO COATING BY HIGH-VELOCITY OXYGEN FUEL DEPOSITION TECHNIQUE

zh-Hans.title: CeO2和La2O3增强相对高速氧燃料喷涂技术制备的WC–12Co涂层力学性能、摩擦学性能及微观组织的影响
zh-Hans.abstract: 高速氧燃料（HVOF）喷涂过程中的脱碳会降低碳化钨-12%钴（WC-12Co）涂层的可加工性。本研究考察了CeO2和La2O3增强相对HVOF喷涂WC-12Co涂层力学性能、摩擦学性能及微观组织特征的影响。以未增强涂层为对照，评估了微观组织、物相组成、结合强度、磨粒磨损、摩擦系数和显微硬度。添加CeO2或La2O3降低了孔隙率并细化了晶粒，而未影响结合强度。与未增强的WC-12Co涂层相比，添加1 wt.% CeO2和La2O3的涂层显微硬度分别提高了6%和4%；未增强涂层的黏附结合强度为73.60 ± 5 MPa。两种改性涂层均表现出更高的结构稳定性、更细的晶粒和更高的致密度。WC-12Co-1La2O3的磨损率最低，为3.5 × 10⁻⁵ mm³/N·m，而WC-12Co-1CeO2的摩擦系数最低，为0.4。由增强相形成的氧化物层提高了耐磨性。对磨损表面的扫描电子显微镜（SEM）观察表明，主要磨损过程表现为磨屑、脱落的碳化物颗粒、SiC晶粒、微裂纹和犁沟。

infographic.key_insight: 向HVOF喷涂的WC–12Co中添加1 wt.% CeO2或La2O3，可在不降低结合强度的情况下减少孔隙、细化晶粒并提高显微硬度。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 添加稀土氧化物为制备更致密、耐磨性能更好的WC–12Co涂层提供了一条途径，可用于对耐磨性要求较高的部件。
method: 采用HVOF喷涂制备未增强及CeO2或La2O3增强的WC–12Co涂层。
比较微观组织、物相组成、结合强度、显微硬度、磨粒磨损和摩擦性能。

title: INVESTIGATION OF THE FORMATION OF STRUCTURE AND WEAR-RESISTANT PROPERTIES OF WC–CO–CR COATINGS PRODUCED BY HVOF AND DETONATION SPRAYING
authors: Arystanbek Kussainov, G.Zh. Zhunissova, Ermakhan Molbossynov, Нуртолеу Магазов, Rashid Kuanyshbay
abstract: The article presents a comparative analysis of WC–Co–Cr cermet coatings deposited by detonation spray (DS) and High Velocity Oxy-Fuel (HVOF) methods. The study included an analysis of the morphology of the initial powders, as well as the microstructure and phase composition of the coatings using Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM) and Energy Dispersive Spectroscopy (EDS). The results show that the use of homogeneous, fully alloyed WC–Co–Cr powder ensures the formation of a dense, layered structure with a uniform distribution of the carbide phase within the metallic matrix. Detonation spraying produces a harder coating (average microhardness 1449 HV), whereas HVOF provides a coating with high density, uniform microstructure, and low friction coefficient (Kt = 0.143). The comparative analysis confirmed that the mechanical and tribological properties of the coatings strongly depend on the powder morphology and the spraying method. These findings allow for the determination of optimal processing conditions for WC–Co–Cr coatings, enhancing wear resistance and durability of machine parts, which is particularly relevant for operation under intensive friction and high load conditions.

infographic.engineering_relevance: Selecting the powder and deposition process can improve coating suitability for machine parts exposed to intensive friction and high loads.

title: Study on Linear Active Disturbance Rejection Control for Current Regulation in a Fast‐Frequency Pulsed Welding Power Supply
authors: Zhiyu He, Liang Zhang, Jing Zhe Wang, Qin Zhang, Zhenmin Wang
abstract: ABSTRACT Fast‐frequency pulsed welding power supplies require current regulation across changing load and dc‐bus conditions. This study develops an application‐oriented linear active disturbance rejection control (LADRC) implementation for a dual‐path phase‐shifted full‐bridge (PSFB) source rated at 400 A dc plus 150 A pulsed current. A control‐oriented model distinguishes load‐dependent damping, commutation duty loss, and analog‐to‐digital converter (ADC) and pulse‐width modulation (PWM) scaling from the nominal controller gain. A first‐order regulator with a second‐order linear extended state observer is implemented on an STM32G474 with a 20‐μs control period. Hardware comparisons include a local incremental proportional–integral (PI) gain scan and repeated electrical tests. In the 400 A branch, the 50 and 100 A step rise times decrease by 25.1% and 28.9%, respectively, although LADRC is not faster at every operating point. Between fixed dc‐bus levels of 544 and 420 V, the mean rise‐time drift over the 30–200 A subset is 15.7% for LADRC and 56.0% for PI. In the pulse branch, the tabulated pulse counts indicate a 45.5% reduction in mean recovery time. The mean amplitude coefficient of variation across three 100‐pulse acquisitions decreases from 4.13% to 1.28% at the tested 50 A operating point. These results establish application‐specific electrical performance, rather than parameter‐independent closed‐loop dynamics or validated welding‐quality gains.
venue: International Journal of Circuit Theory and Applications

zh-Hans.title: 高频脉冲焊接电源电流调节的线性自抗扰控制研究
zh-Hans.abstract: 摘要 高频脉冲焊接电源需要在负载和直流母线条件变化时进行电流调节。本研究针对额定输出为400 A直流电流叠加150 A脉冲电流的双通路移相全桥（PSFB）电源，开发了一种面向应用的线性自抗扰控制（LADRC）实现方案。面向控制的模型将负载相关阻尼、换流占空比损失以及模数转换器（ADC）和脉宽调制（PWM）的比例系数与标称控制器增益区分开来。在STM32G474上实现了配备二阶线性扩张状态观测器的一阶调节器，控制周期为20 μs。硬件对比包括增量式比例–积分（PI）控制的局部增益扫描和重复电气测试。在400 A支路中，50 A和100 A阶跃的上升时间分别缩短了25.1%和28.9%，但LADRC并非在所有工作点都更快。在544 V和420 V两个固定直流母线电压水平之间，30–200 A子集内的平均上升时间漂移，LADRC为15.7%，PI为56.0%。在脉冲支路中，表列脉冲计数表明平均恢复时间缩短了45.5%。在所测试的50 A工作点，三次各100个脉冲的采集中，幅值变异系数的均值从4.13%降至1.28%。这些结果确立的是特定应用下的电气性能，而非与参数无关的闭环动态特性，也不代表经过验证的焊接质量提升。

title: Interpretable ensemble learning for tensile strength prediction and welding process window optimization of friction stir-welded 7N01 aluminum alloy
authors: Xiaocui Wu, Yingjie Zhao, Huijie Zhang, Qi Cheng, Limao Wei, Yuwang Liu
abstract: This study aims to achieve high-accuracy prediction of the ultimate tensile strength (UTS) of friction stir-welded A7N01P-T4 aluminum alloy joints, elucidate the effects of welding parameters on UTS, and optimize the welding process window. Rotational speed, welding speed, and shoulder plunge depth were used as input variables, with UTS as the output. Machine learning models were developed using 27 experimental samples and evaluated by leave-one-out cross-validation. Comparison of decision tree, K-nearest neighbors, and Gaussian process regression identifies decision tree as the best baseline model, with an R 2 of 0.905. An ensemble learning strategy was subsequently introduced to construct a gradient boosting decision tree, increasing R 2 to 0.966, and grid search optimization of its key hyperparameters further improves R 2 to 0.978. SHapley Additive exPlanations analysis shows that the importance of the welding parameters follows the order of welding speed, rotational speed, and shoulder plunge depth, and the identified parameter effects agree well with the experimental results and observed microstructural evolution. The optimized model predicts fully feasible ranges of all the welding parameters for a joint efficiency of at least 90%, and the shoulder plunge depth acts as a key parameter for further refining the high-strength welding process window. These results demonstrate that the proposed approach not only improves the accuracy of UTS prediction but also reveals welding parameter effects and enables optimization of the welding process window, providing a quantitative basis for selecting FSW parameters.
venue: Journal of Materials Research and Technology

zh-Hans.title: 用于搅拌摩擦焊7N01铝合金抗拉强度预测与焊接工艺窗口优化的可解释集成学习
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究旨在高精度预测搅拌摩擦焊A7N01P-T4铝合金接头的极限抗拉强度（UTS），阐明焊接参数对UTS的影响，并优化焊接工艺窗口。以旋转速度、焊接速度和轴肩下压量为输入变量，以UTS为输出变量。利用27个实验样本建立机器学习模型，并采用留一交叉验证进行评估。通过比较决策树、K近邻和高斯过程回归，确定决策树为最佳基线模型，其R²为0.905。随后引入集成学习策略，构建梯度提升决策树，将R²提高至0.966；通过网格搜索优化其关键超参数后，R²进一步提高至0.978。SHapley Additive exPlanations（SHAP）分析表明，焊接参数的重要性由高到低依次为焊接速度、旋转速度和轴肩下压量，且所识别的参数影响与实验结果及观察到的微观组织演变高度一致。优化后的模型预测了接头效率至少达到90%时所有焊接参数的完整可行范围，而轴肩下压量是进一步细化高强度焊接工艺窗口的关键参数。这些结果表明，所提出的方法不仅提高了UTS预测精度，还揭示了焊接参数的影响，并实现了焊接工艺窗口优化，为搅拌摩擦焊（FSW）参数选择提供了定量依据。

title: Investigation of the Effect of HVOF Spray Parameters on the Quality Properties of Cr3C2-20(Ni20Cr) Coating on Ti6Al4V Substrate
authors: Hariharan Venkataraman, Vishal Uttamrao Bagade, V.M. Biju
abstract: Systematic optimization of high-velocity oxy-fuel (HVOF) spray parameters, such as spray distance, powder feed rate, and fuel gas flow rates, requires numerous experiments to determine the conditions that maximize coating quality. In this study, full factorial design (FFD), a more robust and efficient methodology than the traditional one-factor-at-a-time (OFAT) methodology, was employed to investigate the influence of HVOF spray parameters of Cr₃C₂-20(Ni20Cr) coating deposited onto a Ti6Al4V substrate. The design of experiments (DOE) approach using an FFD with 24 experimental runs was employed to evaluate all input factors at two levels. The coating response properties were measured for each experimental run. Analysis of variance (ANOVA) was used to quantify the contribution of each spray parameter to the output responses. The effect of the interaction between spray parameters, such as spray distance, powder feed rate, and fuel gas flow rates, on the coating properties for this substrate-coating combination has scarcely been reported. Hence, a Pareto chart was also utilized to analyze the interaction effects of the spray parameters on coating properties. Finally, acceptable quality attributes such as hardness, porosity, and oxides were established with the spraying parameters, namely, standoff distance, powder feed rate, hydrogen flow rate, and oxygen flow rate, respectively, at the values of 150 mm, 25 g/min, 475 NLPM, and 205 NLPM.

zh-Hans.title: HVOF喷涂参数对Ti6Al4V基体上Cr3C2-20(Ni20Cr)涂层质量特性的影响研究
zh-Hans.abstract: 对喷涂距离、送粉速率和燃气流量等超音速火焰喷涂（HVOF）参数进行系统优化，需要开展大量实验，以确定使涂层质量最优的条件。本研究采用比传统单因素逐次试验（OFAT）方法更稳健、更高效的全因子设计（FFD），考察HVOF喷涂参数对沉积于Ti6Al4V基体上的Cr₃C₂-20(Ni20Cr)涂层的影响。采用包含24次实验的两水平FFD实验设计（DOE）方法，对所有输入因素进行评估。每次实验均测量了涂层的响应特性。采用方差分析（ANOVA）量化各喷涂参数对输出响应的贡献。对于这一基体–涂层组合，喷涂距离、送粉速率和燃气流量等喷涂参数之间的交互作用对涂层性能的影响鲜有报道。因此，还采用帕累托图分析了喷涂参数对涂层性能的交互作用效应。最终，当喷涂距离、送粉速率、氢气流量和氧气流量分别为150 mm、25 g/min、475 NLPM和205 NLPM时，涂层的硬度、孔隙率和氧化物含量等质量指标达到可接受水平。

title: Long-term corrosion behaviors and wear behavior of Fe-based amorphous coatings in different humidity environments
authors: Shuai Cui, Haimin Zhai, Zihan Feng, Xuqiang Li, Wensheng Li, Xiangjuan Fan
abstract: Fe-based amorphous coatings (Fe-based AMCs) were successfully prepared on Q235 carbon steel by detonation spray under different spraying parameters. The corrosion and tribology behaviors of coatings were systematically tested. The droplets show disk-like morphology with the highest circularity and expansion factor, which is crucial to reduce the defects of coatings and to form fine-lamellar-structures coatings with dense microstructure. A higher incidence of porosity defects in the coating is associated with reduced long-term corrosion resistance. Moreover, the tribo-chemical reactions between Si3N4 balls and water molecules play a significant role in wear behaviors for coating in different humidity conditions. The friction coefficient and wear rate of coatings decrease as the humidity conditions increase.

infographic.key_insight: Disk-like droplets with high circularity and expansion promote dense Fe-based amorphous coatings, while greater porosity reduces long-term corrosion resistance and higher humidity lowers friction and wear.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Controlling detonation-spray parameters to minimize coating defects can improve protection of Q235 steel, while service humidity should inform wear-performance assessment.

zh-Hans.title: 铁基非晶涂层在不同湿度环境下的长期腐蚀行为与磨损行为
zh-Hans.abstract: 采用不同喷涂参数，通过爆炸喷涂在Q235碳钢上成功制备了铁基非晶涂层（Fe-based AMCs）。系统测试了涂层的腐蚀行为和摩擦学行为。液滴呈圆盘状形貌，具有最高的圆度和铺展系数，这对于减少涂层缺陷以及形成微观组织致密的细片层结构涂层至关重要。涂层中孔隙缺陷越多，其长期耐腐蚀性越低。此外，Si3N4球与水分子之间的摩擦化学反应对不同湿度条件下涂层的磨损行为具有重要影响。随着湿度升高，涂层的摩擦系数和磨损率降低。

title: Surface Characteristics of Titanium Based Coatings Obtained by Detonation Spraying Under Various Process Conditions
authors: Vyacheslav Sirota, Sergey Savotchenko, Valeriya Strokova, Daniil Podgornyi, Marina Kovaleva
abstract: The surface properties of metal-ceramic coatings based on titanium dioxide are described in dependence on the detonation spraying conditions. It is found that such properties as surface roughness, surface thickness and its hydrophobicity can be controlled in the production process by selecting certain values of the technological parameters of the spraying process. The optimal values of the technological parameters of detonation spraying, ensuring maximum hydrophobicity of the produced coatings are determined. The roughness of the coating surface and the coating thickness depend on the speed of the nozzle passage in accordance with the inverse power law. The roughness and the contact angle depend on spray distance in accordance with a parabolic law. New equations are obtained that can be useful for predicting the characteristics of the coating surface, as well as for determining the optimal mode of spraying the coating, ensuring its best hydrophobicity.

title: Feedstock Morphology Governs Impact-Induced Deformation in Cold Sprayed Metal-Ceramic Composites
authors: Romario A. Wicaksono, Amir Ardeshiri Lordejani, Sara Bagherifard
abstract: The mechanistic understanding of cold spray additive manufacturing for metal-ceramic composites has mainly focused on spray parameters, whereas the role of metallic feedstock morphology remains comparatively underexplored. This study elucidates how spherical and spongy Cu morphologies govern impact-induced deformation, microstructural evolution, and the resulting structure-property relationship in Cu-Al 2 O 3 composite deposits. Multi-scale characterization, including microstructural analysis, nano- and micro-hardness measurements, micro-compression tests, and tribological analyses, reveals distinct strain patterns within the deposits that are influenced by particle morphology. Spherical Cu promotes interfacial strain localization and interfacial metal–ceramic contacts along flattened splats, giving rise to a distinct bimodal grain structure characterized by grain refinement at splat boundaries and larger, unrefined grains within splat cores. This microstructural gradient effectively balances strength and ductility. In contrast, the collapse of the spongy Cu ligament upon impact forms a volumetrically distributed strain-hardened zone, resulting in a more broadly distributed strain accumulation and enhanced ceramic encapsulation. The findings indicate that ceramic particles play an active role in influencing deformation caused by impact, while also passively strengthening the deposits. This dual function is directly reflected in the enhanced performance of the deposits, even at comparable reinforcement fraction. These findings demonstrate that, in addition to the spray parameters, the powder morphology serves as a fundamental governing factor in controlling the deformation mechanisms and deposit performance.

zh-Hans.title: 原料形貌主导冷喷涂金属-陶瓷复合材料中的冲击诱导变形
zh-Hans.abstract: 对金属-陶瓷复合材料冷喷涂增材制造的机理认识主要集中于喷涂参数，而金属原料形貌的作用相对缺乏研究。本研究阐明了球形和海绵状Cu形貌如何主导Cu-Al₂O₃复合沉积体中的冲击诱导变形、微观组织演化及由此形成的组织-性能关系。包括微观组织分析、纳米硬度和显微硬度测量、微压缩试验及摩擦学分析在内的多尺度表征揭示了沉积体内受颗粒形貌影响的不同应变分布模式。球形Cu促进应变在界面处局域化，并促进沿扁平颗粒界面形成金属-陶瓷接触，从而产生明显的双峰晶粒结构，其特征为扁平颗粒边界处的晶粒细化，以及扁平颗粒核心内部较大且未细化的晶粒。这种微观组织梯度有效平衡了强度与延性。相比之下，海绵状Cu韧带在冲击时塌陷，形成在体积内分布的应变硬化区，使应变累积的分布更为广泛，并增强对陶瓷颗粒的包覆。研究结果表明，陶瓷颗粒在被动强化沉积体的同时，也在影响冲击引起的变形方面发挥主动作用。即使增强相含量相近，这种双重作用也直接体现为沉积体性能的提升。这些发现表明，除喷涂参数外，粉末形貌也是控制变形机制和沉积体性能的基本主导因素。

zh-Hans.abstract: 本文研究了使用DNEPR-5M设备在45钢表面制备的AlB12-30 wt.% Al（AB70）和AlB12-70 wt.% Al（AB30）爆炸喷涂涂层的性能。涂层具有以下特征：厚度h ~ 170-200 μm，H μ = 27-29 GPa，HV = 4.35 GPa。分析了复合材料的摩擦学性能随摩擦工况的变化。研究发现，AB70组分具有稳定的摩擦学性能：f = 0.21-0.38，磨损率I = 3.3-8.6 μm/km。涂层试样的耐磨性优于未涂覆的45钢。展示了不同滑动速度和载荷下摩擦后表面结构的变化。确定了两种磨损机制：氧化磨损和黏着-磨粒磨损。研究得出结论，AlB12-Al体系可用于制备爆炸喷涂涂层。关键词：AlB12-Al，爆炸喷涂涂层，显微组织，硬度，摩擦学性能。AlB12-Al体系爆炸喷涂涂层的结构与性能。О.П.Уманський、В.Б.Муратов、В.Є.Шелудько、К.М.Гальцов、О.А.Бондаренко、Т.В.Мосіна、В.Л.Сироватка、І.С.Марценюк、В.Т.Варченко、В.В.Кременицький、А.В.Міницький、О.В.Кущев。本文研究了使用“ДНІПРО-5М”设备在45钢表面制备的AlB12-30 wt.% Al（AB70）和AlB12-70 wt.% Al（AB30）爆炸喷涂涂层的性能。涂层具有以下特征：厚度h ~ 170-200 μm，H μ = 27-29 GPa，HV = 3.67-4.35 GPa。分析了复合材料的摩擦学性能随摩擦工况的变化。研究发现，AB70涂层具有更稳定的摩擦学性能：f = 0.21-0.38，磨损率I = 3.3-8.6 μm/km。涂层试样的耐磨性优于未涂覆的45钢。展示了不同滑动速度和载荷下摩擦后表面结构的变化。确定了两种磨损机制的存在：氧化磨损和黏着-磨粒磨损。研究得出结论，AlB12-Al体系可用于制备爆炸喷涂涂层。

title: STUDY OF TRIBOLOGICAL PROPERTIES OF BIOCOATINGS BY DETONATION SPRAYING METHOD
authors: Жұлдыз Болатқызы Сағдолдина, Daryn Baizhan, Temirlan Alimbekuly, Акбар Сувонович Алибеков
abstract: In this study, bioactive hydroxyapatite coatings were deposited on commercially pure Grade 2 titanium substrates by detonation spraying at different O₂/C₂H₂ ratios in the range of 2.6-3.7. X-ray diffraction analysis confirmed the predominance of the hydroxyapatite phase with partial formation of α-tricalcium phosphate, which is attributed to high temperatures and intense dynamic processes in the detonation jet. The formed coatings exhibit pronounced hydrophobicity, high structural heterogeneity, and a well-developed surface microrelief, promoting improved interaction with bone tissue and accelerated osseointegration. Tribological tests conducted under dry conditions and in Ringer’s solution demonstrated a significant increase in wear resistance compared to uncoated Grade 2 titanium. The best friction characteristics and the lowest wear volume were observed for coatings deposited at O₂/C₂H₂ ratios of 3.0 and 3.3, which is associated with an optimal combination of crystallinity, phase composition, and adhesion strength. Coatings formed under these conditions provide stable tribological behavior in physiological environments. The obtained results confirm the prospects of detonation-sprayed hydroxyapatite for improving the durability, biocompatibility, and operational reliability of titanium implants.

zh-Hans.title: 爆炸喷涂法制备生物涂层的摩擦学性能研究
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究采用爆炸喷涂法，在2.6–3.7范围内的不同O₂/C₂H₂比值下，将生物活性羟基磷灰石涂层沉积于Grade 2工业纯钛基体上。X射线衍射分析证实，涂层以羟基磷灰石相为主，并形成了部分α-磷酸三钙，这归因于爆炸射流中的高温和剧烈动态过程。所形成的涂层表现出显著的疏水性、高度的结构非均质性以及发育充分的表面微观起伏形貌，有助于改善其与骨组织的相互作用并加速骨整合。在干燥条件和林格氏溶液中进行的摩擦学试验表明，与未涂覆的Grade 2钛相比，涂层的耐磨性显著提高。在O₂/C₂H₂比值为3.0和3.3时沉积的涂层表现出最佳摩擦特性和最低磨损体积，这与结晶度、相组成及结合强度的最佳组合有关。在这些条件下形成的涂层在生理环境中具有稳定的摩擦学行为。所得结果证实，爆炸喷涂羟基磷灰石在提高钛植入物的耐久性、生物相容性和服役可靠性方面具有应用前景。

title: Indentation Evaluation of Elastic–Plastic Response and Surface Modifications in Stainless Steel
authors: Канжигит Г.А., Ф. Р. Капсаламова, Aiym Nabioldina, Renat E. Beissenov, Mariya M. Gurariy, Alex A. Volinsky
abstract: This study applies a depth-based description of indentation response to AISI 321 stainless steel and a detonation-sprayed FeNiCoMoW coating. Martens hardness HM was evaluated from the maximum indentation depth, while a residual-depth-based quantity Hpl was calculated using the retained depth. The corresponding hardness ratio Hpl/HM was examined in relation to the retained-depth fraction. Instrumented Vickers indentation was performed on untreated AISI 321 stainless steel and the FeNiCoMoW coating. Maximum and residual indentation depths were obtained from load–displacement curves. Coating morphology was examined by optical microscopy and phase composition by X-ray diffraction. The FeNiCoMoW coating formed a continuous layer with a 145 ± 8 μm thickness. Compared with the substrate, the coating reduced the retained-depth fraction from 0.906 to 0.788 and increased the hardness ratio from 1.22 to 1.61. Indentation hardness increased from 2.3 ± 0.17 GPa for the substrate to 8.65 ± 1 GPa for the coating. X-ray diffraction identified the (Mo,W)₂C carbide crystalline phase together with an fcc (Co,Ni,Fe) solid solution and σ- and μ-type intermetallic compounds. The proposed descriptors provide a compact characterization of indentation response and distinguish retained-depth behavior from conventional contact-depth-based hardness measurements. For the investigated coating, the lower retained-depth fraction and higher hardness indicate a greater recovered-depth contribution during unloading.

zh-Hans.title: 不锈钢弹塑性响应与表面改性的压入评价
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究采用基于深度的压入响应描述方法，对 AISI 321 不锈钢和爆炸喷涂 FeNiCoMoW 涂层进行评价。根据最大压入深度评估马氏硬度 HM，并利用残余深度计算基于残余深度的量 Hpl。考察了相应硬度比 Hpl/HM 与残余深度占比之间的关系。对未经处理的 AISI 321 不锈钢和 FeNiCoMoW 涂层进行了仪器化维氏压入试验。从载荷–位移曲线中获得最大压入深度和残余压入深度。采用光学显微镜观察涂层形貌，并通过 X 射线衍射分析相组成。FeNiCoMoW 涂层形成了厚度为 145 ± 8 μm 的连续层。与基体相比，涂层使残余深度占比从 0.906 降至 0.788，并使硬度比从 1.22 增至 1.61。压入硬度从基体的 2.3 ± 0.17 GPa 增至涂层的 8.65 ± 1 GPa。X 射线衍射鉴定出 (Mo,W)₂C 碳化物晶相、面心立方（fcc）(Co,Ni,Fe) 固溶体以及 σ 型和 μ 型金属间化合物。所提出的描述量可简洁地表征压入响应，并将残余深度行为与传统的基于接触深度的硬度测量区分开来。对于所研究的涂层，较低的残余深度占比和较高的硬度表明卸载过程中深度恢复的贡献更大。

infographic.key_insight: 爆炸喷涂 FeNiCoMoW 涂层提高了 AISI 321 不锈钢的压入硬度，同时降低了残余深度占比，表明卸载过程中深度恢复更大。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该涂层提供了更硬的表面，而基于深度的描述量有助于区分其与未经处理钢材的压入恢复行为。
method: 通过仪器化维氏压入试验测量最大深度和残余深度。
计算马氏硬度 HM、基于残余深度的 Hpl 以及 Hpl/HM。
采用光学显微镜评估形貌；通过 X 射线衍射鉴定物相。
infographic.evidence_signal: 厚度为 145 ± 8 μm 的涂层使压入硬度从 2.3 ± 0.17 GPa 增至 8.65 ± 1 GPa，使残余深度占比从 0.906 降至 0.788，并使 Hpl/HM 从 1.22 增至 1.61。
infographic.watch_item: 仅凭压入试验结果无法确定涂层的附着力、耐磨性或服役耐久性；不应将 Hpl 与传统的基于接触深度的硬度混为一谈。

title: Effect of Vacuum Heat Treatment on the Structural-Phase State of Detonation-Sprayed NiCrAl Coatings
authors: Meruyert Maulet, Жұлдыз Болатқызы Сағдолдина, Nurkhat Bimakhan
abstract: The effect of vacuum heat treatment on the structural-phase state of detonation-sprayed NiCrAl coatings was investigated. The samples were annealed in vacuum at temperatures of 800, 900, 1000, and 1100 °C with a holding time of 4 h. It was established that the as-sprayed coating is characterized predominantly by the presence of β-NiAl and a non-equilibrium lamellar structure formed under conditions of high-velocity detonation deposition and rapid particle cooling. At 800 °C, diffusion processes are activated, and a more complex multiphase state involving Ni–Al- and Cr-containing intermetallic phases is formed. Increasing the temperature to 900 °C promotes further structural and chemical homogenization of the coating while retaining β-NiAl as one of the main phases. At 1000 °C, along with continued homogenization, Cr2O3 and NiO appear, while interdiffusion between the coating and the Fe-containing substrate becomes more pronounced near the interface. After treatment at 1100 °C, the most profound phase transformation is observed, with formation of Al2O3, Cr2O3, NiO, and NiAl2O4, significant redistribution of the Ni–Al intermetallic constituent, and formation of a chemically heterogeneous transition zone with local microvoids. Increasing temperature is also accompanied by changes in surface morphology and a moderate decrease in roughness. Surface roughness showed a non-monotonic temperature dependence, with Ra values of 6, 5.3, 5.3, and 5.9 μm after heat treatment at 800, 900, 1000, and 1100 °C, respectively; the minimum roughness was obtained at 900 °C.

infographic.key_insight: Vacuum annealing progressively transforms detonation-sprayed NiCrAl coatings from a β-NiAl-dominated lamellar state toward homogenized structures and, at 1000–1100 °C, oxide-containing states.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Annealing temperature offers a way to tune coating structure, but higher temperatures increase oxidation and coating–substrate interdiffusion.
method: Deposit NiCrAl coatings by detonation spraying.
Vacuum anneal at 800, 900, 1000, and 1100 °C for 4 h.
Evaluate phase evolution, morphology, interface changes, and surface roughness.
infographic.evidence_signal: Ra was 6.0, 5.3, 5.3, and 5.9 µm at 800, 900, 1000, and 1100 °C, respectively; treatment at 1100 °C produced multiple oxides and a heterogeneous transition zone with local microvoids.
infographic.watch_item: Structural changes alone do not establish service-performance gains; the abstract reports no adhesion, wear, or corrosion testing.
infographic.paper_title: Effect of Vacuum Heat Treatment on the Structural-Phase State of Detonation-Sprayed NiCrAl Coatings

zh-Hans.title: 真空热处理对爆炸喷涂NiCrAl涂层组织与相态的影响
zh-Hans.abstract: 研究了真空热处理对爆炸喷涂NiCrAl涂层组织与相态的影响。样品分别在800、900、1000和1100 °C下进行真空退火，保温时间为4 h。结果表明，喷涂态涂层以β-NiAl为主，并具有在高速爆炸沉积和颗粒快速冷却条件下形成的非平衡层片状组织。在800 °C下，扩散过程被激活，形成了涉及Ni–Al系及含Cr金属间化合物相的更复杂多相状态。温度升至900 °C时，涂层的组织和化学成分进一步均匀化，同时β-NiAl仍为主要相之一。在1000 °C下，随着均匀化持续进行，出现了Cr2O3和NiO，且涂层与含Fe基体之间的互扩散在界面附近变得更加明显。经1100 °C处理后，观察到最显著的相变，形成了Al2O3、Cr2O3、NiO和NiAl2O4，Ni–Al金属间化合物组分发生显著再分布，并形成了具有局部微孔洞的化学成分不均匀过渡区。温度升高还伴随着表面形貌变化和粗糙度的适度降低。表面粗糙度随温度呈非单调变化，在800、900、1000和1100 °C热处理后，Ra值分别为6、5.3、5.3和5.9 μm；在900 °C下获得了最低粗糙度。

infographic.key_insight: 真空退火使爆炸喷涂NiCrAl涂层从以β-NiAl为主的层片状状态逐步转变为均匀化组织，并在1000–1100 °C下转变为含氧化物的状态。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 退火温度提供了一种调控涂层组织的途径，但较高温度会加剧氧化以及涂层与基体之间的互扩散。
method: 采用爆炸喷涂沉积NiCrAl涂层。
评估相演变、形貌、界面变化和表面粗糙度。
infographic.evidence_signal: 在800、900、1000和1100 °C下，Ra分别为6.0、5.3、5.3和5.9 µm；1100 °C处理产生了多种氧化物，并形成了具有局部微孔洞的不均匀过渡区。
infographic.watch_item: 仅凭组织变化无法确定服役性能是否提升；摘要未报告结合强度、磨损或腐蚀测试。
